hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 disruption of lipid metabolism, compared with APOE3, results in impaired late endosome/lysosome function.

paper.title: Lysosomal proteomics reveals mechanisms of neuronal APOE4-associated lysosomal dysfunction.

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal pH was measured ratiometrically with OregonGreen-dextran against a pH-clamp standard curve in Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 from the genomic locus. HsAPOE4 lysosomes were markedly alkalinized (pH 5.86 vs 4.30). APOE4 genotype is the cause; lipid metabolism was not measured. The system is a mouse neuroblastoma line, not human brain cells.
findings.quote: We found that HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibit dramatic lysosomal alkalinization (pH = 5.86) compared to HsAPOE3 (pH = 4.30) cells (Figure 1C–E)
findings.summary: APOE4-expressing Neuro-2a lysosomes are alkalinized (pH 5.86 vs 4.30 in APOE3).
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 genomic locus

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal proteolysis was measured with Magic Red Cathepsin B. HsAPOE4 cells showed significantly decreased cathepsin B substrate cleavage compared with HsAPOE3 cells.
findings.quote: We found that the HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibited significantly decreased MR-CTSB proteolysis compared to HsAPOE3-expressing cells, in line with their decreased lysosomal acidity (Figure 1F,G).
findings.summary: APOE4 reduces lysosomal cathepsin B activity relative to APOE3.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: LysoTracker Deep Red staining intensity, a surrogate combining endolysosomal number and acidity, was significantly reduced in HsAPOE4 cells versus HsAPOE3 cells.
findings.quote: We found that the LysoTracker intensity was significantly reduced in HsAPOE4-expressing cells (Figure 1A,B), suggesting either endolysosomal alkalinization or a reduction in endolysosomal density.
findings.summary: APOE4 lowers LysoTracker staining of acidic compartments.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: FCCP-induced mitophagy was measured with mtKeima. Induction was weaker in HsAPOE4 than HsAPOE3 cells, and co-treatment with BafA1 abolished the genotype difference, implicating lysosomal acidification. Under basal conditions, mitophagy was modestly impaired in HsAPOE4 cells.
findings.quote: While FCCP triggered mitophagy in both HsAPOE3- and HsAPOE4-expressing cells, its induction was stronger in the HsAPOE3-expressing cells (Figure 1I,J).
findings.summary: APOE4 cells show weaker lysosome-dependent mitophagy, and the difference is abolished by BafA1.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 with mtKeima

findings.finding_description: LAMP1 staining showed that lysosomal density was not decreased in HsAPOE4 cells. This null result argues that the reduced LysoTracker signal reflects acidification defects rather than fewer lysosomes.
findings.quote: We therefore stained the cells for the lysosomal membrane marker LAMP1, finding that the lysosomal density was not decreased in HsAPOE4 cells (Fig. S1B-C).
findings.summary: Lysosome number (LAMP1) is not reduced by APOE4.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: LysoIP proteomics comparing HsAPOE4 lysosomes with both HsAPOE3 and APOE-null lysosomes found accumulation of lipid/glycan regulators (e.g. ACSL4, ACBD3, NEU1, PIP4P1, SACM1L), APOE itself, and trafficking proteins in APOE4 lysosomes. This links APOE4 to lipid-related remodeling of the lysosomal proteome, but it is a compositional surrogate rather than a functional readout.
findings.quote: lipid/glycan-regulators (ACSL4, ACBD3, GALNT2, MAN2B1, NEU1, PIP4P1, SACM1L, PIP4P1/TMEM55B, UXS1) (Figure 3B,C, Figure S3C)
findings.summary: APOE4 lysosomes accumulate lipid-regulating proteins relative to APOE3 and APOE-null lysosomes.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3/APOE4/none; TMEM192-3xHA LysoIP proteomics

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal pH in HsAPOE3 cells was comparable to that in APOE-null parental cells, whereas APOE4 cells were alkalinized relative to both (APOE-null pH 4.58). This indicates an APOE4-specific gain of toxicity rather than a loss of APOE3 function.
findings.quote: In contrast, the lysosomal pH was comparable between HsAPOE3 and HsAPOE−/− cells (Figure 1E).
findings.summary: APOE3 does not alter lysosomal pH versus APOE-null cells; the defect is specific to APOE4.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3, APOE4, or no human APOE

findings.finding_description: Autophagy was assessed by LC3–lysosome colocalization and LC3-II:LC3-I ratios. Autophagy was largely functional in APOE4 cells, with only slightly dampened basal autophagy, a partially null result for broader endolysosomal dysfunction.
findings.quote: Autophagy appeared generally functional in these cells, despite the basal autophagy being slightly dampened in HsAPOE4 cells (Fig. S1D-F).
findings.summary: Autophagy is largely intact in APOE4 cells, with only slightly reduced basal autophagy.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: GPN-evoked release measured with a lysosome-targeted calcium indicator showed comparable lysosomal Ca2+ content between APOE3 and APOE4 cells. This is a null result for this lysosomal parameter.
findings.quote: we found lysosomal calcium levels to be comparable between HsAPOE3 and HsAPOE4-expressing cells (Fig. S1G-L), particularly after correcting for lysosomal density (Fig. S1M).
findings.summary: Lysosomal calcium stores are unaffected by APOE4.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: In the LysoIP proteome, LGALS3BP was depleted from APOE4 lysosomes despite unchanged whole-cell levels. Lysosomal LGALS3BP was also sensitive to APOE status and to BafA1 proton-pump blockade.
findings.quote: This approach highlighted the unique case of LGALS3BP, a protein whose expression was reduced in lysosomes despite unchanged whole-cell expression levels (Figure 3E).
findings.summary: APOE4 lysosomes are selectively depleted of LGALS3BP.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3/APOE4/none; LysoIP proteomics

findings.finding_description: An siRNA knockdown screen of APOE4-dysregulated lysosomal proteins used LysoTracker as the readout. It indicated that LGALS3BP depletion and TMED5 accumulation could drive the APOE4-associated lysosomal impairment. This is a mechanistic step downstream of APOE4 and not lipid-mediated.
findings.quote: This highlighted that the HsAPOE4-associated lysosomal impairments could be driven by LGALS3BP depletion and TMED5 accumulation (Fig. S4G).
findings.summary: Knockdown experiments implicate LGALS3BP loss and TMED5 accumulation in APOE4 lysosomal defects.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 with siRNA knockdowns

findings.finding_description: Peptide-level lysosomal proteomics in human APOE-expressing Neuro-2a cells showed that most LGALS3BP was depleted from HsAPOE4 lysosomes compared with HsAPOE3. Peptides from the SRCR and BTB domains persisted. The authors attribute the persistence to the alkaline lysosomal pH in APOE4 cells, which they infer rather than measure here.
findings.quote: This approach highlighted that while most LGALS3BP was depleted in HsAPOE4 lysosomes, a number of abundant peptides from its SRCR- and BTB-domains did not show a discernible difference.
findings.summary: APOE4 lysosomes are depleted of full-length LGALS3BP, but some domain peptides persist, which the authors interpret as a sign of impaired degradation from alkalinization.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE3 vs APOE4 (lysosomal proteomics)

findings.finding_description: Dextran-Oregon Green imaging in HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells showed that LGALS3BP knockdown, which mimics the APOE4-associated depletion, modestly alkalinized lysosomal pH and nearly halved lysosomal density. APOE4 scrambled-control values were plotted for reference.
findings.quote: finding that LGALS3BP knockdown modestly alkalinized the lysosomal pH, but nearly halved the lysosomal density (Figure 4C–E).
findings.summary: Mimicking APOE4's LGALS3BP depletion in APOE3 cells slightly raises lysosomal pH and roughly halves lysosome density.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3, siRNA LGALS3BP knockdown

findings.finding_description: In HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells, LGALS3BP knockdown markedly decreased LysoTracker staining of acidic compartments.
findings.quote: We found that LGALS3BP depletion markedly decreased the LysoTracker staining in healthy HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells (Figure 4A,B).
findings.summary: LGALS3BP knockdown reduces LysoTracker staining in APOE3 cells.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3, siRNA knockdown

findings.finding_description: CRISPRi suppression of LGALS3BP in APOE3 human iPSC-derived neurons decreased LysoTracker staining, whereas the TMED10 positive control increased it. This extends the LGALS3BP effect to human neurons but does not compare APOE genotypes.
findings.quote: We confirmed that while TMED10 inhibition increased LysoTracker staining in iPSC-derived neurons, LGALS3BP inhibition decreased staining, suggesting that LGALS3BP is necessary to maintain lysosomal integrity across neuronal models (Figure 4H,I).
findings.summary: In human iPSC neurons, LGALS3BP suppression lowers LysoTracker staining, so the protein is needed to maintain the acidic lysosomal compartment.
findings.experimental_system: human CRISPRi iPSC-derived neurons (HsAPOE3)

findings.finding_description: Magic Red Cathepsin B assays found no significant proteolytic impairment after LGALS3BP knockdown in HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells. This is a null result for the depletion-driven degradative defect.
findings.quote: In line with its modest influence on lysosomal acidification, we could not detect significant proteolytic impairments upon LGALS3BP knockdown (Figure 4F,G).
findings.summary: LGALS3BP knockdown does not significantly impair lysosomal cathepsin B proteolysis.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3, siRNA knockdown

findings.finding_description: Affinity-purification mass spectrometry of the LGALS3BP interactome showed that HsAPOE4 favored LGALS3BP binding to TMED10 and decreased binding to FAF2 (VCP-ERAD lysosome routing). FAF2 abundance was lower in APOE4 cells. This offers a possible trafficking route but does not measure lysosomal function.
findings.quote: Among a few altered interactors, we found that HsAPOE4 favored interactions between LGALS3BP and the ER-to-Golgi cargo receptor TMED10, associated with a trend toward higher TMED10 expression (Figure 4J,K; Table S2D-E).
findings.summary: APOE4 shifts LGALS3BP's interaction partners away from a lysosome-routing protein (FAF2) and toward TMED10.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 vs APOE4, AP-MS

findings.finding_description: A repurposed LAMP1-proximity ligation assay compared isogenic APOE3 and APOE4 human iPSC-derived mixed neuronal cultures. APOE4 neurons had less lysosomal LGALS3BP and more lysosomal TMED5 than APOE3 neurons. This compares genotypes, but lysosomal function is inferred from lysosomal protein content and lipid metabolism was not measured.
findings.quote: In concordance with our observations in Neuro-2a cells, we found that APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons harbored less lysosomal LGALS3BP and more lysosomal TMED5 compared to their APOE3 counterparts (Figure 6B,C).
findings.summary: Isogenic APOE4 human iPSC neurons show altered lysosomal protein content (less LGALS3BP, more TMED5) versus APOE3.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic APOE3/APOE4 human iPSC-derived mixed neuronal cultures (incl. GABAergic interneurons)

findings.finding_description: Immunofluorescence colocalization of LGALS3BP and TMED5 with the lysosomal marker CTSD in APOE3 vs APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons. There was no difference in lysosomal LGALS3BP and a slight increase in lysosomal TMED5. Widespread non-lysosomal staining confounded both readouts.
findings.quote: While we could not observe differences in lysosomal LGALS3BP localization by this approach (Fig. S6B-C), we could observe a slight increase in lysosomal TMED5 immunoreactivity and colocalization (Fig. S6D-E).
findings.summary: Colocalization showed no APOE4 effect on lysosomal LGALS3BP and only a slight TMED5 increase in human iPSC neurons.
findings.experimental_system: isogenic APOE3/APOE4 human iPSC-derived neurons

findings.finding_description: In HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, TMED5 knockdown significantly enhanced lysosomal acidification (Oregon-green pH) without changing lysosomal density, with HsAPOE3 shown as reference. This perturbs a downstream mediator rather than APOE genotype or lipid metabolism, in a mouse cell line.
findings.quote: We confirmed by lysosomal Oregon-green pH measurements that knockdown of TMED5 significantly enhanced lysosomal acidification in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, while not impacting the lysosomal density (Figure 5C–E).
findings.summary: TMED5 knockdown restores lysosomal acidity in APOE4-expressing Neuro-2a cells.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4 (APOE3 reference)

findings.finding_description: In HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, TMED5 knockdown significantly increased Magic Red Cathepsin B lysosomal proteolysis.
findings.quote: We found that TMED5 removal significantly enhanced lysosomal proteolysis of the MR-CTSB indicator in HsAPOE4 cells (Figure 5F,G).
findings.summary: TMED5 knockdown increases cathepsin B activity in APOE4 Neuro-2a cells.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4

findings.finding_description: In HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, TMED5 knockdown enhanced mitophagy (mtKeima), shifting mitochondria toward acidic compartments under basal and FCCP-induced conditions.
findings.quote: Concurrently, we found that TMED5 knockdown significantly enhanced mitophagy in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, shifting mitochondria toward more acidic environments both under basal and FCCP-induced conditions (Figure 5H,I).
findings.summary: TMED5 knockdown increases mitophagy in APOE4 Neuro-2a cells.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4

findings.finding_description: In HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells, overexpression of human TMED5-GFP decreased LysoTracker staining and Magic Red Cathepsin B proteolysis, mimicking the APOE4 phenotype.
findings.quote: Conversely, in HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells we found that TMED5 overexpression caused the opposite phenotype, resulting in decreased LysoTracker staining (Figure 5J,K) and lysosomal proteolysis (Figure 5L,M).
findings.summary: TMED5 overexpression in APOE3 cells reduces lysosomal acidity and proteolysis.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3

findings.finding_description: LysoTracker staining of acidic compartments in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells after TMED5 knockdown. The authors state the knockdown reversed lysosomal defects.
findings.quote: we found that HsAPOE4-associated TMED5 accumulation in lysosomes caused lysosomal defects that could be reversed by its acute removal (Figure 5A,B).
findings.summary: TMED5 knockdown reverses LysoTracker-measured lysosomal defects in APOE4 Neuro-2a cells.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4

findings.finding_description: LAMP1-TMED5 proximity ligation assay in neurons from post-mortem AD brains: APOE4 cases accumulated lysosomal TMED5. This is AD tissue, so it falls outside the non-AD scope of the hypothesis.
findings.quote: On the other hand, we found that neurons from APOE4 AD brain samples accumulate lysosomal TMED5, indicating that lysosomal TMED5 accumulation is a highly conserved event in APOE4 neuropathology (Figure 6F–G).
findings.summary: APOE4 AD brain neurons show increased lysosomal TMED5 (AD context).
findings.experimental_system: post-mortem human AD brain neurons, APOE3 vs APOE4

findings.finding_description: LAMP1-LGALS3BP proximity ligation assay in AD brain neurons: lower lysosomal LGALS3BP in APOE4 cases was a non-significant trend. This is a null result, in AD tissue.
findings.quote: While we observed a general trend of lower lysosomal LGALS3BP levels in APOE4 neurons, this was not statistically significant (p = 0.24; Figure 6D,E).
findings.summary: No significant APOE4 effect on lysosomal LGALS3BP in AD brain neurons.
findings.experimental_system: post-mortem human AD brain neurons, APOE3 vs APOE4

findings.finding_description: LGALS3BP interactome in HsAPOE4 vs HsAPOE3 Neuro-2a cells: APOE4 increased its interaction with TMED10 and reduced its interaction with FAF2 (VCP-ERAD lysosome routing), and FAF2 abundance was lower in APOE4 cells. This bears only indirectly on lysosomal function.
findings.quote: Of note, FAF2 protein abundance is significantly lower in HsAPOE4 cells, which may serve as a mechanism to prevent the association of LGALS3BP with this lysosome-routing interaction partner (Figure 4K; Table S2F).
findings.summary: APOE4 alters LGALS3BP interactors linked to lysosomal routing in Neuro-2a cells.
findings.experimental_system: mouse Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: Lysosomal proximity ligation assay (LAMP1 with LGALS3BP or TMED5) was quantified in human iPSC-derived neurons of different APOE genotypes. The authors report that APOE4-associated lysosomal protein changes also occur in these neurons. Lysosomal protein composition is a surrogate for lysosomal function, and lipid metabolism was not measured.
findings.quote: These results illustrate that the APOE4-associated and functionally relevant lysosomal protein changes also manifest in human postmitotic neurons susceptible to neurodegeneration.
findings.summary: APOE4-associated changes in lysosomal LGALS3BP/TMED5 localization are seen in human iPSC-derived neurons.
findings.experimental_system: human iPSC-derived neurons (APOE genotypes), LAMP1 proximity ligation assay

findings.finding_description: In neuronal cells expressing human APOE4 rather than APOE3, the authors report substantial lysosomal alkalinization that impairs lysosomal proteolysis and mitophagy. This is a summary statement in the Discussion; the cells are a mouse Neuro-2a line, not human cells, and no lipid mediator was tested.
findings.quote: While neuronal cells express less APOE4 than astrocytes, we observe a substantial degree of lysosomal alkalinization, which impairs both lysosomal proteolysis and mitophagy.
findings.summary: Neuronally expressed APOE4 alkalinizes lysosomes and impairs proteolysis and mitophagy.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells expressing human APOE4 vs APOE3

findings.finding_description: Knockdown of LGALS3BP in HsAPOE3-expressing cells reduced lysosomal density and, to a lesser extent, acidity. This implicates a proposed mediator of APOE4 lysosomal dysfunction. It does not fit classes 1-4 cleanly (class 5) because APOE genotype was not varied and the mediator is not a lipid-metabolism variable.
findings.quote: Specifically, by reducing LGALS3BP expression in HsAPOE3 cells, we found that LGALS3BP maintains lysosomal density, and to a lesser extent lysosomal acidity.
findings.summary: LGALS3BP knockdown in APOE3 cells reduces lysosomal density and acidity, mimicking the APOE4 phenotype.
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE3, LGALS3BP knockdown

findings.finding_description: Silencing App or Psen2 did not affect lysosomal function in HsAPOE4-expressing cells. This is a null result arguing that APP/PSEN2 accumulation is downstream of, not causal for, APOE4 lysosomal impairment. It is classed 5 because it tests an alternative route rather than the APOE4 to lysosome link itself.
findings.quote: Intriguingly, we found that silencing App or its associated Psen2 did not affect lysosomal function in HsAPOE4-expressing cells
findings.summary: App/Psen2 knockdown does not rescue lysosomal function in APOE4 cells (null).
findings.experimental_system: Neuro-2a cells expressing human APOE4, siRNA knockdown

findings.finding_description: In BLSA cohort brain proteomics, APOE4 lysosome-associated proteins correlated positively with APOE4 dosage. These are aged and AD-inclusive human brains, which falls outside the hypothesis scope, and protein abundance is only a surrogate for lysosomal function.
findings.quote: Proteomic data from the Baltimore Longitudinal Study of Aging (BLSA) cohort revealed a significant positive correlation between APOE4 lysosome-associated proteins (Figure 6H) with APOE4 dosage (Figure 6I, cor = 0.37, p = 3.6E-4).
findings.summary: Lysosomal APOE4-associated proteins scale with APOE4 dosage in aged human brain tissue.
findings.experimental_system: post-mortem human brain proteomics (BLSA cohort, AMP-AD)

findings.finding_description: In Banner cohort brain proteomics, APOE4-dysregulated lysosomal proteins correlated positively with APOE4 dosage. These are aged and AD-inclusive brains, outside the hypothesis scope, and protein abundance is a surrogate readout.
findings.quote: the Banner Sun Health Research Institute (Banner) cohort revealed significant positive correlation between all APOE4-dysregulated lysosomal proteins relative to APOE3 controls (Figure 6K) with APOE4 dosage (Figure 6L, cor = 0.32, p = 7.2E-6).
findings.summary: APOE4-dysregulated lysosomal proteins correlate with APOE4 dosage in the Banner cohort.
findings.experimental_system: post-mortem human brain proteomics (Banner cohort, AMP-AD)

findings.finding_description: Neurons in APOE4 AD post-mortem brain showed accumulation of lysosomal TMED5 by LAMP1 proximity ligation assay. This is AD tissue, outside the hypothesis scope, and lysosomal composition is a surrogate for function.
findings.quote: we found that neurons from APOE4 AD brain samples accumulate lysosomal TMED5, indicating that lysosomal TMED5 accumulation is a highly conserved event in APOE4 neuropathology (Figure 6F–G).
findings.summary: Lysosomal TMED5 accumulates in neurons of APOE4 AD brains.
findings.experimental_system: post-mortem human AD brain neurons, LAMP1 proximity ligation assay
